en:
<CLT=cltMIND>You don't see a blackboard like this
every day...

<CLT=cltMIND>Why do they need to block it when we can
already leave the school?

<CLT=cltMIND>Those are the lockers Shuichi and I
came out of.
<CLT=cltMIND>It feels like that happened so long ago...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us...
The audio's gonna crack from so many speakers.
